FileSystemManager.writeFile(Object object)

Write a file. If a directory does not exist in the path, writing the file fails. If the file exists, the content is overwritten. If the file does not exist, a new file is created and the content is written(Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
filePath String Yes File path to write to. (The local user path can only be in the usr directory. It can be a relative directory. However, the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory, and cannot be a temporary path or cache path.)
data String/ArrayBuffer Yes Text or binary data to be written, which can be null.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
encoding String utf8 No Specifies the character encoding to be written to the file.
encoding
Valid Value Description
ascii
base64 Note that if Base64 encoding is selected, only the Base64 content needs to be transferred for data. Do not transfer the Data URI prefix. Otherwise, the fail base64 encode error error message is displayed. For example, pass aGVsbG8= instead of data:image/png;base64,aGVsbG8=
ucs2 Read in little-endian order
ucs-2 Read in little-endian order
utf16le Read in little-endian order
utf-16le Read in little-endian order
utf-8
utf8 Default value
latin1

Sample Code

let fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();
fs.writeFile({
  filePath: `${ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/test.txt`,
  data: 'data',
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail(err) {
    console.log(err);
  }
});

Tips

  1. The maximum length of the file name to be written is 255 characters. If the file name is too long, the API fails to be invoked.
  2. The file size is 10 MB.
